name: recoscan
description: 周会前先知道这个项目下周会在哪三件事上出事——项目台账喂进去，带证据引用的体检卡出来
description_zh: 五个纯函数指标（承诺兑现率、阻塞时长、依赖未闭合、决策未落任务、变更密度）对项目台账做体检；每条风险带指向台账行的证据引用与下一步建议，诊断与处方分开；不做根因推断、不做风险预测。零联网、零第三方依赖（仅 Node.js 内置模块），结果为标准 findings JSON 可进 CI 或周报。
description_en: Health-check your project ledger before the weekly meeting. Five deterministic metrics (promise-keeping rate, blocking duration, unclosed dependencies, decisions-without-tasks, change density), each finding with evidence rows and a next step. Zero network, zero third-party dependencies, Node.js builtins only.
author: 弈枢AI Easur Work
